description: Header file defining the LocalizationService class and related properties for managing localization and UI language settings in the CalculatorApp. It includes enums, static constants, and method declarations for retrieving locale-specific formatting and font information.

classes.name: LocalizationService
classes.description: A singleton class providing localization services such as font management, language settings, and regional formatting for the CalculatorApp.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the LocalizationService.

methods.name: GetFlowDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the flow direction (LTR or RTL) based on current language settings.

methods.name: IsRtlLayout
methods.description: Checks if the current layout is right-to-left.

methods.name: GetOverrideFontApiValues
methods.description: Determines if font API values are overridden.

methods.name: GetLanguage
methods.description: Returns the current language as a string.

methods.name: GetLanguageFontFamilyForType
methods.description: Retrieves the font family for a specified font type.

methods.name: GetFontFamilyOverride
methods.description: Returns the font family override string.

methods.name: GetFontScaleFactorOverride
methods.description: Returns the font scale factor override for a given font type.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareDecimalFormatter
methods.description: Provides a decimal formatter configured for regional settings.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareDateTimeFormatter
methods.description: Provides a date-time formatter for regional settings with specified format.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareDateTimeFormatter
methods.description: Provides a date-time formatter with specific format, calendar, and clock identifiers.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareCurrencyFormatter
methods.description: Provides a currency formatter configured for regional settings.

methods.name: OverrideWithLanguage
methods.description: Overrides the language setting with a specified language code.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts a vector of strings or other types based on locale collation.

methods.name: GetNarratorReadableToken
methods.description: Converts a raw token string into a narrator-readable string.

methods.name: GetNarratorReadableString
methods.description: Converts a raw string into a narrator-readable string.

methods.name: GetLanguageFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font for a specific language font type.

methods.name: ParseFontWeight
methods.description: Parses a font weight string into a FontWeight object.
